jobs.title: Front Office Executive
jobs.description:
**Company Name: Sri Narayani Hospital \& Research Centre, Vellore.** 

**Location: Vellore**

**Job Title:** **Front Office Executive**

**Job Description**

We are seeking a versatile and empathetic Front Office Executive to join our healthcare team. In this multi\-faceted role, you will be the primary point of contact for patients, overseeing the end\-to\-end patient journey—from initial intake and admission to financial counseling, billing, discharge coordination and master health checkup. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, delivers exceptional patient support, and possesses strong administrative and financial management skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Welcome patients warmly and manage the complete check\-in and intake process.
* Provide comprehensive patient counseling regarding admission procedures, clinic/hospital policies, and available facility amenities.
* Guide patients and families through sensitive healthcare decisions with empathy and clarity.
* Collect and verify patient demographics, insurance coverage, and identification documentation.
* Explain estimated costs, co\-pays, deductibles, and out\-of\-pocket expenses clearly to patients prior to procedures or admissions.
* Process daily patient billing, collect payments, and issue itemized receipts.
* Handle pre\-authorizations, insurance claims submission, and financial clearance workflows.
* Resolve patient billing inquiries and assist with setting up manageable payment plans.
* Coordinate with medical staff, nursing teams, and billing to finalize discharge summaries and final bills.
* Process smooth, timely patient check\-outs and clear final payments.
* Manage front desk phone lines, schedule follow\-up appointments, and respond to incoming inquiries.
* Maintain accurate electronic health records (EHR) and ensure compliance with healthcare privacy regulations.
* Provide comprehensive patient counseling regarding admission procedures, clinic/hospital policies, and available facility amenities.
* Guide patients and families through sensitive healthcare decisions with empathy and clarity.
* Collect and verify patient demographics, insurance coverage, and identification documentation.
* **Experience:** 0–3\+ years of front desk or healthcare administration experience.
* **Qualification:** Bachelor's Degree / Master's Degree,

**To apply:**

Contact: 8438252589 / 7358387160

Email: recruitment@snhrc.org

Pay: From ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: HR Trainee
jobs.description:
**Company:** Otomatiks  
**Location:** Vellore, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reports To:** HR Manager / HR Head

About the Role

We are looking for a **motivated and organized HR Trainee** to join our team in Vellore. The candidate will receive practical exposure to various areas of Human Resources, including recruitment, employee coordination, attendance, documentation, onboarding, and day\-to\-day HR administration.

This role is ideal for a candidate who is looking to build a career in Human Resources and is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with employees and management.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Recruitment \& Hiring**

* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, referrals, and other channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Coordinate interview schedules with candidates and hiring managers.
* Communicate with candidates regarding interview schedules, selection, and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.
* Assist with joining and onboarding processes.

**2\. Employee Coordination**

jobs.title: Trainee - QMS
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**


Sicame India is part of Sicame Group, a global industrial Group founded in France in 1955 and present worldwide. Specialized in products and services related to transmission and distribution of electrical energy, renewables, electro\-mobility, safety equipment and industrial applications, it became the largest independent entity in its sector today.


Sicame India was established in 2006 to support the “MAKE IN INDIA” vision and meet India’s evolving power needs. Today, with a modern manufacturing facility and accredited engineering and testing center in Chennai, Sicame India serves major utilities and industries with innovative, reliable, and sustainable solutions while helping build the future of energy in India.

**Your responsibilities:**

**QEHS Document Control**

* Maintain and control QEHS documentation, including SOPs, procedures, work instructions, forms, and system documents.
* Ensure proper revision control, document updates, version management, and document availability.
* Support periodic review and updating of controlled documents.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation for audit readiness.


2\. **Internal Audits – QEHS \& 5S**

* Coordinate and support the internal audit schedule.
* Assist internal auditors and auditees in planning and executing audits.
* Follow up on audit findings and ensure proper documentation of observations and non\-conformities.
* Track audit findings and follow up with respective stakeholders for timely closure of non\-conformities (NCs).
* Support 5S audit activities and maintain relevant records.


3\. **External Audits \& Certifications**

* Provide support during external audits, customer audits, and certification audits.
* Coordinate with various departments to ensure documentation and records are available for audit readiness.
* Support preparation of audit\-related documents and evidence.
* Track Corrective Action Requests (CARs) raised during audits and follow up for timely closure.
* Maintain records related to audit observations, corrective actions, and closures.


4\. **KPI Monitoring \& Follow\-up**

* Collect relevant QEHS and departmental KPIs from respective stakeholders.
* Consolidate and maintain KPI data and reports.
* Assist in monitoring KPI trends and identifying deviations.
* Support periodic KPI review meetings and follow\-up actions.


5\. **Customer Complaint Follow\-up**

* Prepare Minutes of Meeting (MOM) for customer complaint review meetings.
* Coordinate with the Cross\-Functional Team (CFT) to track action items.
* Follow up with stakeholders on corrective and preventive actions.
* Consolidate open points and provide status updates for customer complaint review meetings.
* Maintain appropriate records of complaint\-related actions and closures.


6\. **Suggestions \& Continuous Improvement**

* Record improvement suggestions received from Cross\-Functional Teams (CFTs).
* Track the progress and status of suggestions and continual improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with respective stakeholders for implementation updates.
* Track and document the effectiveness of implemented improvements.
* Support initiatives related to quality improvement, waste reduction, process improvement, and workplace organization.

**Required profile:**

* Basic knowledge of Integrated Management System (IMS) standards:


	+ ISO 9001 – Quality Management System
	+ ISO 14001 – Environmental Management System
	+ ISO 45001 – Occupational Health \& Safety Management System
* Knowledge of Internal Audit practices and preferably certified/trained as an IMS Internal Auditor.
* Good documentation and record management skills.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Good follow\-up and task\-tracking capabilities.
* Basic analytical and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Microsoft Excel / PowerPoint will be an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn.
